summary.text: Robby Mills is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 4 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mills was born in Henderson, Kentucky, graduated from Henderson County High School in 1985, and earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Oral Roberts University in 1989.

His career experience includes running his family's dry cleaning service and a business that assisted homeowners following disasters, and he served as a city commissioner in Henderson from 1998 to 2016.
Mills served in the Kentucky House of Representatives, District 11, from 2017 to 2019, and took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 1, 2019.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Committee on Committees, Families and Children, Health and Welfare, Natural Resources and Energy, Rules, and State and Local Government committees.
